competences.description: Stretches your arm to attack the enemy and Stuns the target for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times, each attack having a 50% chance to decrease the Defense for 2 turns.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Recovers the Attack Bar of all allies, except yourself, in proportion to the no. of harmful effects granted on yourself each turn. Also ignores all harmful effects excluding the Oblivion effect and inability effects granted on yourself. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
The target will gain immunity against all harmful effects.
